description: This file defines a Kotlin interface `RatedStore` that provides an abstraction for tracking whether a user has rated specific content identified by `contentId`. It includes a session-scoped, in-memory implementation `Session` which maintains a set of rated content during the app runtime.

classes.name: RatedStore
classes.description: An interface for checking and marking whether a given contentId has been rated by the user.

classes.name: RatedStore.Session
classes.description: A session-scoped in-memory implementation of `RatedStore` that uses a mutable set to track rated content IDs during the app runtime.

methods.name: isRated
methods.description: Returns true if the specified contentId has already been marked as rated in this store.

methods.name: markRated
methods.description: Marks the specified contentId as rated.
